summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: Package ships a postinstall hook (`node beacon.cjs`) and a `main` entry (`index.js`) that both invoke `beacon.cjs`'s `fire()` function, which POSTs installer host identifiers (os.hostname(), __dirname, process.cwd(), process.version) over plaintext HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The declared `main` is a Proxy stub returning no-op functions for any accessed property, so the package provides no real component functionality — its only effect on install or import is to beacon host and path metadata to the attacker-controlled IP. The scoped name `@ppa-web-components/*` resembles an internal/private registry namespace, consistent with a dependency-confusion probe designed to fire from a victim organization's build system.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
